blocks.text: Iltimos, taklif va ruxsat — xushmuomala ingliz tili

O'zbekchada xushmuomalalikni «**-sangiz**», «**-ib bera olasizmi**», «**maylimi**», «iltimos» kabi qo'shimcha va so'zlar beradi. Ingliz tilida esa asosiy vosita — **modal fe'lli savol**: Could you ...?, May I ...?, Would you like ...? Buyruq gap (Give me the bill.) inglizchada «please» bilan ham qo'pol eshitilishi mumkin. can / could (→ qizil kitob, 30-dars), Would you like ...? (→ qizil kitob, 34-dars) va Shall I ...? (→ 21–22-darslar) bilan tanishsiz; bu darsda ular **xushmuomalalik darajasi** bo'yicha tartibga solinadi.
Iltimos: Can you ...? Could you ...? Would you ...?

**Can you** ...? — oddiy, oila va do'stlar orasida. **Could you** ...? — xushmuomalaroq va eng universal: notanish odamga ham, hamkasbga ham. **Would you** ...? — xushmuomala, lekin ba'zan qat'iyroq eshitiladi. Eng yumshoq shakllar: **Do you think you could** ...?, **I wonder if you could** ..., **Would you mind** + `-ing`? — katta iltimos qilganda yoki notanish odamni bezovta qilganda. **possibly** so'zi iltimosni yanada yumshatadi: Could you **possibly** ...?

rows: **Do you think you could** ...? / **I wonder if you could** ...
**I wonder if you could** help me.

items.text: **Could you** turn the air conditioning down a bit? It's freezing in here.
items.translation: Konditsionerni biroz **pasaytira olasizmi**? Bu yer juda sovuq.

items.text: **I wonder if you could** check my application before I send it.

blocks.text: **mind** — «qarshi bo'lmoq, malol kelmoq». Shuning uchun **Would you mind** + `-ing`? so'zma-so'z «...ish sizga malol kelmaydimi?» degani: Would you mind **closing** the door? Inkor: Would you mind **not** smoking? Ruxsat so'rash: **Do you mind if I** + Present Simple? yoki yumshoqroq **Would you mind if I** + Past Simple? Diqqat: javob mantiqqa ko'ra beriladi! **No, not at all** / **No, go ahead** — «yo'q, qarshi emasman» = **ruxsat**. «**Yes**» desangiz — «ha, qarshiman» bo'lib chiqadi.

items.text: **Would you mind holding** the door for me? My hands are full.
**Do you mind if I** open the window? — No, not at all.

blocks.text: Ruxsat va narsa so'rash: Can I ...? Could I ...? May I ...?

Ruxsat so'rashda ham daraja bor: **Can I** ...? — oddiy; **Could I** ...? — xushmuomalaroq; **May I** ...? — rasmiy (ish suhbati, mehmonxona, rasmiy yig'ilish). **Is it all right / OK if I** ...? — norasmiy va yumshoq. Narsa so'rashda: **Can / Could I have** ...? — do'kon, kafe, restoranda: Could I have the bill, please? «**Can I get** ...?» — Amerikadan kirib kelgan, Britaniyada yoshlar orasida ishlatiladi, lekin ba'zilarga qo'pol eshitiladi; **Could I have** — doim xavfsiz.

rows: Yes, of course. / Sure, go ahead.
Sorry, I'm using it right now.
Could you wait a moment, please?
**Is it OK if I** leave early?
**Do you mind if I** sit here?

items.text: **May I** ask why you decided to leave your previous job?
items.translation: Oldingi ishingizni nega tark etishga qaror qilganingizni **so'rasam maylimi**?

items.text: **Could I have** a table by the window, please?

blocks.text: Taklif: Shall I ...? Would you like me to ...?

**Yordam taklif qilish**: **Can I** help? / **Shall I** ...? / **Would you like me to** ...? / **Let me** ... / **I'll** ... (→ 21-dars). «Would you like I help» emas — **Would you like me to** help? **Narsa taklif qilish**: **Would you like** ...? (xushmuomala), **Will you have** ...? (British mehmondo'stligi: Will you have some more tea?), **Do you want** ...? (norasmiy). **Taklifnoma** (bir joyga chaqirish): **Would you like to** come ...?, **How about** + `-ing`?, **Why don't you** ...? O'zbekchada: «**-aymi?**», «**-ib beraymi?**», «**...ni xohlaysizmi?**».

items.text: You look lost. **Would you like me to** show you the way to the station?
**Will you have** another piece of cake? — Just a small one, thanks.
items.translation: Yana bir bo'lak **tort yeysizmi**? — Kichkinasini, rahmat.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Would you mind to open the window?» → Would you mind **opening** (mind dan keyin `-ing`); «May you help me?» → **Could** you help me? (May faqat ruxsat so'rashda: May **I** ...?); «Would you like I help you?» → Would you like **me to** help you?; «Do you mind if I sit here? — Yes, sit down» → **No, not at all** / **No, go ahead** (Yes — «qarshiman»); «Give me a coffee, please» → **Could I have** a coffee, please?

Qaysi shaklni tanlashni bilmasangiz — **Could you ...?** (iltimos) va **Could I ...?** (ruxsat) deyavering: ular deyarli har qanday vaziyatda to'g'ri va xushmuomala. Iltimos qanchalik katta va odam qanchalik notanish bo'lsa, shuncha uzunroq shakl tanlang: Can you ... → Could you ... → Would you mind ... → I wonder if you could ...

rows: Can / Could / Would you ...?, Would you mind `-ing`?, Do you think you could ...?
Can / Could / May I ...?, Is it OK if I ...?, Do / Would you mind if I ...?
**Do you mind if I** sit here?

Would you like ...?, Will you have ...?, Do you want ...?
Would you like to ...?, How about `-ing`?, Why don't you ...?

examples.title: Requests: **Can you** ...? **Could you** ...?
examples.description: Biror kishidan iltimos qilish: Can you ...? (oddiy), Could you ...? (xushmuomala), Would you ...? Will you ...? — oilada.

sentences.text: **Can you** pass me the salt, please? — Here you are.
sentences.translation: Tuzni **uzatib yuborasizmi**? — Mana, oling.

sentences.text: **Could you** speak a bit more slowly? My English isn't very good yet.
sentences.translation: Biroz sekinroq **gapira olasizmi**? Ingliz tilim hali unchalik yaxshi emas.

sentences.text: Excuse me, **could you** tell me the way to the Registan?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, Registonga qanday borishni **aytib bera olasizmi**?

sentences.text: Aziz, **can you** pick up some bread on your way home?
sentences.translation: Aziz, uyga qaytishda non **olib kela olasanmi**?

sentences.text: **Would you** close the window, please? It's getting cold in here.
sentences.translation: Derazani **yopib qo'yasizmi**, iltimos? Bu yer sovib ketyapti.

sentences.text: Sorry to interrupt, but **could you** sign this form before you leave?
sentences.translation: Gapingizni bo'lganim uchun uzr, lekin ketishdan oldin bu anketaga **imzo chekib bera olasizmi**?

sentences.text: When you've got a minute, **can you** have a look at my presentation?
sentences.translation: Bir daqiqa vaqtingiz bo'lganda, taqdimotimga **ko'z yugurtirib bera olasizmi**?

sentences.text: Please **could you** send me the photos from the wedding?
sentences.translation: To'ydagi suratlarni menga **yuborib bera olasizmi**, iltimos?

sentences.text: **Could you** possibly lend me your car for the day? Mine is in the garage.
sentences.translation: Bir kunga mashinangizni **qarzga bera olmaysizmi**? Meniki ustaxonada.

sentences.text: Mum, **will you** wake me up at seven tomorrow? I've got an early lecture.
sentences.translation: Oyi, ertaga meni soat yettida **uyg'otib qo'yasizmi**? Erta ma'ruzam bor.

examples.title: Very polite: **Would you mind** -ing?
examples.description: Katta iltimos yoki notanish odam bilan: Would you mind + -ing?, Do you think you could ...?, I wonder if you could ..., Is there any chance you could ...?

sentences.text: **Would you mind waiting** here for a moment? The doctor is with a patient.
sentences.translation: Shu yerda bir daqiqa **kutib tursangiz**? Shifokor bemorni ko'ryapti.

sentences.text: **Do you think you could** help me with my CV this weekend?
sentences.translation: Shu dam olish kunlari rezyumemga **yordam bera olarmikansiz**?

sentences.text: Excuse me, **would you mind moving** your bag? I'd like to sit down.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, sumkangizni **olib qo'ysangiz**? O'tirmoqchi edim.

sentences.text: I was wondering if **you could** give me a lift to the station.
sentences.translation: Meni bekatgacha **olib borib qo'ya olarmikansiz**, deb o'ylab turgandim.

sentences.text: Please, **would you mind not smoking** near the children?
sentences.translation: Iltimos, bolalar yonida **chekmasangiz**.

sentences.text: Sorry to bother you, but **do you think you could** turn the music down a little?
sentences.translation: Bezovta qilganim uchun uzr, lekin musiqani biroz **pasaytira olmaysizmi**?

sentences.text: Is there any chance **you could** finish the translation by Thursday?
sentences.translation: Tarjimani payshanba kunigacha **tugata olishingiz mumkinmi**?

sentences.text: Madina, **would you mind checking** my essay for mistakes before I submit it?
sentences.translation: Madina, topshirishimdan oldin inshomni xatolarga **tekshirib bera olasanmi**?

sentences.text: I wonder if **you could** recommend a good dentist near the city centre.
sentences.translation: Shahar markazi yaqinida yaxshi stomatologni **tavsiya qila olarmikansiz**?

sentences.text: If it isn't too much trouble, **could you** water my plants while I'm in London?
sentences.translation: Agar qiyin bo'lmasa, men Londonda bo'lganimda gullarimga **suv quyib tura olasizmi**?

examples.title: Things and permission: **Can I** ...? **May I** ...?
examples.description: Narsa so'rash (Can / Could I have ...?) va ruxsat so'rash (Can / Could / May I ...?). May — rasmiyroq.

sentences.text: **Can I have** a glass of water, please? I'm really thirsty.
sentences.translation: Bir stakan **suv bersangiz**? Juda chanqadim.

sentences.text: **Could I have** the bill, please? We're in a bit of a hurry.
sentences.translation: **Hisobni keltirsangiz**, iltimos? Biroz shoshyapmiz.

sentences.text: **May I** use your phone? Mine has just died.
sentences.translation: Telefoningizdan **foydalansam maylimi**? Menikining quvvati tugadi.

sentences.text: Excuse me, **can I** sit here, or is this seat taken?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, shu yerga **o'tirsam bo'ladimi** yoki joy band?

sentences.text: **Could I** leave work an hour early today? I've got a dentist's appointment.
sentences.translation: Bugun ishdan bir soat erta **ketsam bo'ladimi**? Stomatologga yozilganman.

sentences.text: Mr Brown, **may I** ask you a few questions about your experience in sales?
sentences.translation: Janob Braun, savdo sohasidagi tajribangiz haqida bir necha savol **bersam maylimi**?

sentences.text: Dad, **can I** borrow the car tonight? I'll fill it up with petrol.
sentences.translation: Dada, bugun kechqurun mashinani **olib tursam bo'ladimi**? Benzin quyib qo'yaman.

sentences.text: Hello, **could I** speak to the manager, please? It's about my order.
sentences.translation: Salom, menejer bilan **gaplashsam bo'ladimi**? Buyurtmam haqida edi.

sentences.text: **May I** suggest that we take a short break before the next item on the agenda?
sentences.translation: Kun tartibidagi keyingi masaladan oldin qisqa **tanaffus qilishni taklif qilsam maylimi**?

sentences.text: Kate asked if she **could** take a day off to look after her sick mother.
sentences.translation: Keyt kasal onasiga qarash uchun bir kun **dam olsa bo'ladimi**, deb so'radi.

examples.title: **Do you mind if I** ...? **Is it all right if I** ...?
examples.description: Ruxsat so'rash: Do you mind if I + Present, Would you mind if I + Past, Is it all right / OK if I ...? Javob: No, not at all = ruxsat.

sentences.text: **Do you mind if I** open the window? — No, go ahead.
sentences.translation: Derazani **ochsam qarshi emasmisiz**? — Yo'q, bemalol, oching.

sentences.text: **Is it all right if I** bring a friend to the party? — Of course, the more the merrier.
sentences.translation: Bazmga do'stimni **olib kelsam bo'ladimi**? — Albatta, qancha ko'p bo'lsak, shuncha yaxshi.

sentences.text: **Would you mind if I** recorded the lecture on my phone?
sentences.translation: Ma'ruzani telefonimga **yozib olsam qarshi bo'lmaysizmi**?

sentences.text: **Is it OK if I** pay by card? I haven't got any cash on me.
sentences.translation: Karta orqali **to'lasam bo'ladimi**? Yonimda naqd pul yo'q.

sentences.text: Sorry, **do you mind if I** take this chair? — Actually, my friend is sitting there.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, shu stulni **olsam maylimi**? — Aslida bu yerda do'stim o'tiribdi.

sentences.text: **Do you mind** me asking how much you paid for the flat?
sentences.translation: Kvartiraga qancha to'laganingizni **so'rasam xafa bo'lmaysizmi**?

sentences.text: Dilnoza asked her boss whether it **would be all right if** she worked from home on Fridays.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza boshlig'idan juma kunlari uydan **ishlasa bo'ladimi**, deb so'radi.

sentences.text: Before the meeting starts, **is it OK if** I make a quick phone call?
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish boshlanishidan oldin tezgina **qo'ng'iroq qilib olsam bo'ladimi**?

sentences.text: I hope you **don't mind if** I leave a little early — my son has a concert tonight.
sentences.translation: Biroz erta **ketsam qarshi bo'lmaysiz**, degan umiddaman — bugun o'g'limning konserti bor.

sentences.text: **Would it be all right if** we arrived at about nine instead of eight?
sentences.translation: Sakkiz emas, soat to'qqizlarda **kelsak bo'ladimi**?

examples.title: Offering help: **Shall I**? **Would you like me to** ...?
examples.description: Yordam taklif qilish: Can I ...?, Shall I ...?, Would you like me to ...?, Do you want me to ...?, Let me ..., I'll ... O'zbekchada «-ib beraymi?».

sentences.text: That bag looks heavy — **shall I** carry it for you?
sentences.translation: Bu sumka og'irga o'xshaydi — **ko'tarib beraymi**?

sentences.text: **Would you like me to** book a table for tonight? — Yes, please, that would be great.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun uchun **stol band qilib qo'yaymi**? — Ha, iltimos, zo'r bo'lardi.

sentences.text: **Shall I** call a taxi, or would you prefer to walk?
sentences.translation: **Taksi chaqiraymi** yoki piyoda yurishni afzal ko'rasizmi?

sentences.text: **Can I** help you with anything? — No, thanks, I'm just looking.
sentences.translation: Sizga biror narsada **yordam bera olamanmi**? — Yo'q, rahmat, shunchaki ko'ryapman.

sentences.text: You look exhausted. **Let me** make you a cup of tea.
sentences.translation: Juda charchaganga o'xshaysiz. Sizga bir piyola **choy damlab beray**.

sentences.text: If you're busy, **I'll** collect the kids from school today.
sentences.translation: Agar band bo'lsangiz, bugun bolalarni maktabdan **o'zim olib kelaman**.

sentences.text: Jasur, **do you want me to** explain the new software to you?
sentences.translation: Jasur, yangi dasturni senga **tushuntirib beraymi**?

sentences.text: The printer is jammed again. **Shall I** ring the IT department?
sentences.translation: Printer yana tiqilib qoldi. IT bo'limiga **qo'ng'iroq qilaymi**?

sentences.text: Since you're new here, **would you like me to** show you around the office?
sentences.translation: Bu yerda yangisiz, sizga ofisni **ko'rsatib chiqaymi**?

sentences.text: Oliver **offered to** drive us to the airport, which was really kind of him.
sentences.translation: Oliver bizni aeroportga **olib borishni taklif qildi**, bu uning juda mehribonligi edi.

examples.title: Offers and invitations: **Would you like** ...?
examples.description: Narsa taklif qilish (Would you like ...?, Will you have ...?, Do you want ...?) va biror joyga chaqirish (Would you like to ...?, How about ...?, Why don't you ...?).

sentences.text: **Would you like** some more plov? — Just a little, thank you; it's delicious.
sentences.translation: Yana bir oz **palov solaymi**? — Ozgina, rahmat, juda mazali.

sentences.text: **Will you have** another cup of tea before you go?
sentences.translation: Ketishdan oldin yana bir piyola **choy ichasizmi**?

sentences.text: We're having a barbecue on Saturday — **would you like to** come?
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni kabob qilyapmiz — **kelishni xohlaysizmi**?

sentences.text: **Do you want** a lift home? I'm driving past your street anyway.
sentences.translation: Uyingizgacha **olib borib qo'yaymi**? Baribir ko'changiz yonidan o'taman.

sentences.text: Madina, **how about** joining us for dinner at the new Georgian restaurant?
sentences.translation: Madina, yangi gruzin restoranida biz bilan **kechki ovqatga qo'shilsangchi**?

sentences.text: **Help yourself** to the salad — there's plenty for everyone.
sentences.translation: Salatdan **olavering** — hammaga yetadi.

sentences.text: Kate, **would you like** to join our book club? We meet every second Thursday.
sentences.translation: Keyt, kitobxonlar klubimizga **qo'shilishni xohlaysizmi**? Har ikkinchi payshanba yig'ilamiz.

sentences.text: **Can I get you** anything to drink while you wait?
sentences.translation: Kutib turganingizda ichishga biror narsa **olib kelaymi**?

sentences.text: **Why don't you** come and stay with us in Samarkand for a few days?
sentences.translation: Nega bir necha kunga Samarqandga, biznikiga **kelib qolmaysiz**?

sentences.text: Our colleagues from Manchester **invited** us **to visit** their office next spring.
sentences.translation: Manchesterdagi hamkasblarimiz bizni kelasi bahorda o'z ofislariga **tashrif buyurishga taklif qilishdi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: at a hotel reception
examples.description: Suhbat: mehmonxonada ro'yxatdan o'tish — iltimos, ruxsat va taklif bir vaziyatda.

sentences.text: — Good evening. **Could I** check in, please? The booking is under the name Karimov.
sentences.translation: — Xayrli kech. **Ro'yxatdan o'tsam bo'ladimi**? Bron Karimov nomiga.

sentences.text: — Of course. **Could I** see your passport, please?
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Pasportingizni **ko'rsam bo'ladimi**?

sentences.text: — Here you are. **Is it possible to** have a room with a view of the old town?
sentences.translation: — Mana. Eski shahar ko'rinadigan **xona olsam bo'ladimi**?

sentences.text: — Let me check. Yes, we've got one on the fifth floor. **Would you like** it?
sentences.translation: — Hozir tekshiraman. Ha, beshinchi qavatda bitta bor. **Uni olasizmi**?

sentences.text: — Perfect. And **could you** give me a wake-up call at six tomorrow?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Ertaga soat oltida **uyg'otish uchun qo'ng'iroq qila olasizmi**?

sentences.text: — No problem. **Would you like** breakfast in your room or in the restaurant?
sentences.translation: — Muammo yo'q. Nonushtani xonangizga **olib kelaylikmi** yoki restoranda qilasizmi?

sentences.text: — In the restaurant, thanks. Oh, and **is it OK if I** park my car outside?
sentences.translation: — Restoranda, rahmat. Ha, yana: mashinamni tashqarida **qoldirsam bo'ladimi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, but **would you mind leaving** your keys with us, just in case?
sentences.translation: — Ha, lekin har ehtimolga qarshi kalitlarni bizga **qoldirib ketsangiz**?

sentences.text: — Not at all. **Can you** tell me where the nearest pharmacy is?
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Eng yaqin dorixona qayerdaligini **aytib bera olasizmi**?

sentences.text: — It's just round the corner. **Shall I** mark it on a map for you?
sentences.translation: — Shundoq burilishda. Xaritada **belgilab beraymi**?

examples.title: Mixed: polite English at work and at home
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: iltimos, ruxsat, yordam va taklifnoma — turli vaziyatlarda.

sentences.text: **Could you** keep an eye on my bag while I buy a coffee?
sentences.translation: Qahva olib kelgunimcha sumkamga **qarab tura olasizmi**?

sentences.text: **May I** introduce our new colleague, Nilufar, who has just joined us from Fergana?
sentences.translation: Farg'onadan hozirgina bizga qo'shilgan yangi hamkasbimiz Nilufarni **tanishtirsam maylimi**?

sentences.text: **Shall we** take a break and continue after lunch?
sentences.translation: **Tanaffus qilib**, tushlikdan keyin **davom ettiramizmi**?

sentences.text: Tom wanted to know if he **could** borrow my notes from the lecture he missed.
sentences.translation: Tom o'zi qatnasha olmagan ma'ruza bo'yicha qaydlarimni **olib tursa bo'ladimi**, deb so'radi.

sentences.text: Sorry, **would you mind** speaking up a little? People at the back can't hear.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, biroz **balandroq gapira olasizmi**? Orqadagilar eshitmayapti.

sentences.text: Thanks for the invitation — I**'d love to** come, but I'm in Oxford that weekend.
sentences.translation: Taklif uchun rahmat — **kelishni juda istardim**, lekin o'sha dam olish kunlari Oksfordda bo'laman.

sentences.text: If you need anything else, **just let me know**, and I'll bring it straight away.
sentences.translation: Yana biror narsa kerak bo'lsa, **ayting**, darhol olib kelaman.

sentences.text: **Is it all right if** the kids play in the garden while we talk?
sentences.translation: Biz gaplashib turganimizda bolalar bog'da **o'ynasa bo'ladimi**?

sentences.text: **Do you think you could** lower the price a little if I buy two?
sentences.translation: Ikkitasini olsam, narxni biroz **tushira olarmikansiz**?

sentences.text: Next time you're in Bukhara, **you must** come and have dinner with us.
sentences.translation: Keyingi safar Buxoroga kelsangiz, albatta biznikiga **kechki ovqatga keling**.
